(Japanese: '''レイコ''' ''Reiko'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP053|The Purr-fect Hero]]''. 

Reiko is a sweet lady who is sometimes hard on the children of the school. She had promised the children that she would let them see some Pokémon for [[Kids Day]]. However, the three Trainers she wanted to bring were unable to show up. Because of this, {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} offered to let the children see their Pokémon instead.
